faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Warangal JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Warangal is 16th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Tech/B.E or M.Tech/M.E degree in relevant fields like Computer Science, IT, AI, or ECE, as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 30 years, with relaxations available for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 42,000 per month, depending on qualifications and NET/GATE status.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this government job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Ensure all required documents are attached and the subject line is correctly formatted.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates applying for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an interview to assess the suitability of the candidates for the role.

faq.question: Q8. Does NIT Warangal offer any age relaxation for specific categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided for SC/ST/OBC candidates, women, and persons with disabilities, up to 5 years.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Warangal is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q10. Where is NIT Warangal located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Warangal is located in Warangal, Telangana, with the pincode 506004.
